grounding.observation: Actual18 neutral drape and front image exist and are rejected for molded anatomy and collar edge.19 repairs those observed failures, not a hypothetical pose.
grounding.comparison: Prior13–17 lacked this real neutral proof; none is erased.

expert_coverage.observation: Torso fabric bridging, neckline boundary quality, supported neutral drape, shoulder/armpit and cuff bend interfaces are separately observable.
expert_coverage.comparison: No cloth detail or extra noise compensates for a body-shaped surface.

film_alignment.observation: Neutral studio is a form test only, not a lower replacement for accepted Pashtun or finished supporting costume.

preferences.observation: Use the remaining approved correction internally, no routine algorithm question; stop on another failure rather than hiding it.
preferences.comparison: Two-correction ceiling and no-new-spend scope remain binding.

reference_roles.observation: Neutral local donor is anatomical support. Accepted film and faithful rearing keep their separate eventual look/action roles.
reference_roles.comparison: No still-frame claim about continuous rearing.

method.observation: Rest garment front gets low-frequency ease to bridge muscles; six cut-boundary smoothing iterations precede bounded outside fit and real settle. Source snapshot explicitly evaluates the inactive owning scene instead of comparing unevaluated identity matrices.
method.comparison: No relaxed solve-displacement guard or unchanged posed-shell rerun. Ease may still fail visually, in which case bending stays blocked.

interfaces.observation: All three neutral image steps are native dependencies of the bend. Each needs actual visual review, not automatic numeric qualification.
interfaces.comparison: Bend failure cannot trigger more unapproved modifications; production pose transfer remains outside this test.

efficient_quality.observation: Single neutral subject, then one75-degree flexion only if justified; no complete-scene render or second actor.
efficient_quality.comparison: The explicit prerequisite is preserved rather than replaced with another cheap but irrelevant mathematical test.

authority.observation: Final correction19/max19 on the existing task. Existing local donor, no new spending/uploads or motion allowance change.
authority.comparison: A bend test is a planned successor, not a new repair allowance. Failure ends further construction.

strongest_counterexample: Added rest ease could settle back into pectoral embossing or leave a tent-like front. The source-scene evaluation could still drift at reopen. Either failure blocks bending. Even a good neutral shirt may collapse at the bend, which must fail without further unapproved tuning.
